header.title: Things I've built
header.subtitle: Personal projects built end to end — each one fully dynamic, with its own custom CMS.

projects.title: Photography Studio Website
projects.summary: A photography website with a full CMS and an online session booking system.
projects.description: A portfolio and business website for a photographer. Everything on the site — galleries, packages, services and page content — is managed from a custom admin panel. Visitors can browse work by category and book a photo session online, and the admin manages incoming bookings from the dashboard.
features: Fully CMS-driven pages, galleries and packages
Online booking system for photo sessions
Booking management from the admin dashboard
projects.role: Solo — design, backend, CMS and deployment

projects.title: Real Estate Portal
projects.summary: A real estate website with a full CMS, property bookings and online payments.
projects.description: A property listing platform where the admin adds and manages properties, photos, prices and details through a custom CMS. Visitors can search listings, view property details and book a property with an online payment, while the admin tracks bookings and payment status.
features: Property listings managed through the CMS
Search and filter by location, type and price
Admin view of bookings and payment status

projects.title: Ved Mandir
projects.summary: A fully dynamic temple website with its own CMS.
projects.description: A website for Ved Mandir where temple administrators manage events, festivals, pooja timings, galleries and announcements from a CMS. Every section of the site is dynamic, so content can be updated without any code changes.

projects.title: Solar Company Website
projects.summary: A corporate website for a solar energy company, powered by a custom CMS.
projects.description: A business website for a solar company showcasing its products, services and completed installations. The company manages services, projects, testimonials and enquiries from its own admin panel.
features: CMS for services, products and projects
Enquiry management in the admin panel

projects.title: Visitor Management System
projects.summary: A web app to register, track and report on visitors to an office or premises.
projects.description: A visitor management system that replaces the paper register. Reception registers visitors with their details and purpose of visit, records check-in and check-out times, and the admin can search visitor history and view reports.
features: Visitor registration with purpose of visit
